evals.prompt: Add POST /products that creates a product in memory and returns it with an id. Validate the body: name is a required non-empty string, price is a positive number, tags is an optional array of strings. Reject unknown fields. Invalid input must return 400 with details.
evals.expected_output: Validation applied app-wide (ValidationPipe with whitelist/forbidNonWhitelisted, or Standard Schema validation with a strict schema); valid bodies return 201.
assertions: A valid body returns 201 with an id
price sent as the string "5" returns 400 (no silent coercion of body numbers)

evals.prompt: GET /users/:id and POST /users return the passwordHash field. Make sure passwordHash is never serialized in any user response, now or in future user endpoints.
evals.expected_output: Centralized response shaping (ClassSerializerInterceptor + @Exclude, or StandardSchemaSerializerInterceptor with a response schema) instead of deleting the field per route.
assertions: GET /users/1 returns the user without passwordHash
POST /users returns the created user without passwordHash
Exclusion is centralized (global interceptor / serializer / response schema), not per handler
Uses Nest's documented serialization (ClassSerializerInterceptor + @Exclude, or StandardSchemaSerializerInterceptor)

evals.prompt: Add GET /items?page=&limit= returning { page, limit, items } from a static list. page and limit arrive as query strings: convert them to integers, default page=1 and limit=20, cap limit at 100, and return 400 for non-numeric or out-of-range values (page < 1, limit < 1 or > 100).
evals.expected_output: Query DTO or schema with transformation and defaults; numbers in the response are numbers.
assertions: No params returns page 1 and limit 20 as numbers
[docs] Query parsing uses pipes or a validated query DTO/schema, not manual parsing in the service
